description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to handling multimodal memory data, including file type specifications, normalization, classification, and embedding support checks.

methods.name: normalizeMemoryMultimodalModalities
methods.description: Normalizes an array of modality selections, returning all modalities if 'all' is included or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeMemoryMultimodalSettings
methods.description: Normalizes raw settings object into a structured MemoryMultimodalSettings object with defaults.

methods.name: isMemoryMultimodalEnabled
methods.description: Checks if multimodal memory is enabled based on settings.

methods.name: getMemoryMultimodalExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves file extensions associated with a given modality.

methods.name: buildMemoryMultimodalLabel
methods.description: Builds a label string for a modality and file path.

methods.name: buildCaseInsensitiveExtensionGlob
methods.description: Creates a case-insensitive glob pattern for a file extension.

methods.name: classifyMemoryMultimodalPath
methods.description: Classifies a file path into a modality based on its extension and current settings.

methods.name: normalizeGeminiEmbeddingModelForMemory
methods.description: Normalizes a model string by removing certain prefixes.

methods.name: supportsMemoryMultimodalEmbeddings
methods.description: Determines if a provider and model support memory multimodal embeddings.
